questions.q: Which two countries jointly ruled Vanuatu before 1980?
questions.why: It was called the New Hebrides.

questions.q: What was Vanuatu called before independence?
questions.why: It became independent in 1980.

questions.q: Who was Vanuatu's first Prime Minister?
questions.why: He was an Anglican priest.

questions.q: Which 1980 rebellion on Espiritu Santo was called the 'Coconut War'?
questions.why: Papua New Guinea troops ended it.

questions.q: Which cyclone devastated Vanuatu in 2015?
questions.why: It was a Category 5 storm.

questions.q: Which earthquake hit Port Vila in December 2024?
questions.why: It damaged buildings in the capital.

questions.q: Which British royal was worshipped by villagers on Tanna?
questions.why: They called him a son of the mountain spirit.

questions.q: What is the capital of Vanuatu?
questions.why: It is on Efate island.

questions.q: Which island is famous for land diving, the origin of bungee?
questions.why: Men jump from towers with vines on their ankles.

questions.q: Which ocean is Vanuatu in?
questions.why: It is a chain of about 80 islands.

questions.q: Which chief's domain is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It includes a burial site on Artok island.

questions.q: Which active volcano on Tanna lets visitors look into the crater?
questions.why: It is one of the most accessible volcanoes.

questions.q: Which beach on Espiritu Santo is often voted among the best?
questions.why: It has white sand.

questions.q: Which island has a famous underwater post office?
questions.why: You can post waterproof postcards.

questions.q: Which island has two lava-lake volcanoes?
questions.why: Marum and Benbow are its volcanoes.

questions.q: Which national sport has Vanuatu's beach team done well in?
questions.why: Its women's team won Pacific titles.

questions.q: Who became Prime Minister of Vanuatu in 2025?
questions.why: He took office in February.

questions.q: Which sand-drawing art is on UNESCO's list?
questions.why: It is drawn with one finger.

questions.q: What is Vanuatu's currency?
questions.why: Its code is VUV.

questions.q: Which creole language is spoken across Vanuatu?
questions.why: English and French are also official.

questions.q: Which cargo cult on Tanna awaits a figure called John Frum?
questions.why: It began in the 1930s.

questions.q: Which drink made from a root is popular in Vanuatu's kava bars?
questions.why: Vanuatu kava is very strong.

questions.q: Which famous wreck off Espiritu Santo is a top dive site?
questions.why: It was a troop ship that hit a mine.

questions.q: Which pudding of grated root crops is the national dish?
questions.why: It is cooked in an earth oven.

questions.q: What was Vanuatu once named in a 'happiest country' index?
questions.why: It topped the 2006 Happy Planet Index.

questions.q: Which blue water holes on Espiritu Santo are popular for swimming?
questions.why: They are spring-fed.

questions.q: Which Vanuatu people are famous for their 'nambas' dress?
questions.a: Big Nambas and Small Nambas of Malekula
questions.why: They are known by the size of their dress.

questions.q: Which pig tusks are a sign of rank in Vanuatu?
questions.why: They appear on the flag.

questions.q: Which festival on Pentecost features the land diving each spring?
questions.why: It is held from April to June.

questions.q: Which Tanna festival brings tribes together to dance?
questions.why: It includes the Toka dance.
